question: The Men's Junior Hockey Asia Cup 2023, which was won by India, was held at _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Oman**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Men's Junior Hockey Asia Cup 2023 was held in **Oman**.
 
• India emerged as the winner of the tournament.
 
• Oman has been a popular venue for various international sporting events, showcasing its capability to host large-scale tournaments.
 
• The competition featured teams from across Asia, making it a significant event in the junior hockey calendar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Men's Junior Hockey Asia Cup is an important platform for young hockey players in Asia to showcase their talent and gain international experience.
 
• The tournament helps in the development of hockey in the region by providing exposure to high-level competition for junior players.
 
• India's victory in the 2023 edition adds to its impressive record in the tournament, further establishing its dominance in junior hockey in Asia.
